title: Isolate HTTP clients built from a reused service-proxy builder
summary: Factories built from one service-proxy builder now isolate both late advice and request processors. Only the later factory added the transport header, even when a fresh client came from the first factory afterward.

change.description: Each built factory now snapshots its request processor and proxy customizer lists. Later builder mutations should affect clients created from later factories only.

notes: The advice test counted actual adapter calls. The header test ran all three service methods to the adapter without short-circuiting.
